fact: Guinea-Bissau's customs directorate reviewed with an African Development Bank mission on 2026-10-08 its migration from SYDONIA++ to SYDONIA World, which the mission head said had passed 80% execution, with the remaining applications and modules still to be installed.

UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme reports ASYCUDAWorld operational across all computerised customs offices, including the Port of Bissau, Bissau International Airport and the Sao Domingos, Gabu and Bafata offices, after migration from ASYCUDA++.
The Guinea-Bissau customs administration says it officially launched an air electronic manifest module in SYDONIA World on 17 September 2026, built with IATA, to receive advance cargo information.

The Direcao-Geral das Alfandegas' service order GDGA 10/26 says declarations are registered in SYDONIA World and its ASYVal valuation module takes effect on 1 May 2026, with value alerts resolved in the system before clearance.
The customs directorate says Guinea-Bissau formally presented SYDONIA World, migrating from SYDONIA++, with training of customs staff under way.
